answer: Each new agent must lock a 5,000 POA bond and attest from a hardware enclave that answers a fresh nonce. A falcon verifier rejects reused quotes and jointly slashes any cluster that shares one chip or one image. A written fable of uniqueness is ignored unless the quote verifies on-chain. Nonces are issued in a sudden gale with a 90-second deadline, so an operator cannot walk a single device across many aliases; every extra sybil needs its own enclave, bond, and live response.
